# Binary fixtures

`invoice-text-merge.pdf` — issue #2669's reproduction sample: a real
e-invoice (电子发票/增值税专用发票 layout) redacted in place by the
reporter — names, tax IDs, addresses, amounts and the QR block replaced
with fictional values at the same boxes, vector geometry untouched — and
published in the issue for this exact purpose. It pins the banded-form
column refinement (`augmentGridStreamColumns`).
